## Description

After MFA the user picks a facility ("Choose where you are working today") listing each membership with role. `/v1/me/context` returns user, active membership, permissions and feature flags. Configurable idle timeout per tenant (default 15 min on shared-device mode, 8 h max session); unsaved drafts are kept locally (encrypted, no PHI in plain localStorage) and on re-auth the user must re-confirm the patient (F-05a). Users can see and revoke their sessions/devices; admins can revoke any staff session.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a user with two memberships, when they sign in, then they must choose a facility and the session is scoped to it; switching facility re-scopes without re-entering MFA.
- [ ] **AC2.** After the idle timeout the session ends and the "Session expired" screen (F-05a) appears; signing in again returns to the previous route and asks to confirm the patient before continuing.
- [ ] **AC3.** Revoking a session from "My devices" or by an admin ends it within 60 seconds on the next request.
- [ ] **AC4.** No patient data is stored in localStorage/sessionStorage in clear text (automated check in Playwright).
- [ ] **AC5.** `/v1/me/context` never returns permissions the role does not grant.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
